summary: Problems that arise from spreading and using information — copyright infringement, piracy, plagiarism, misinformation — and using Kazakhstan's e-government resources safely.

theory.title: Problems of disseminating and using information

blocks.content: Creations of the mind — software, music, films, books, designs, inventions, logos — that belong to their creators and are protected by law (**copyright**, **patents**, **trademarks**).

blocks.title: Problems
rows: Copying, distributing or using software without a licence
Loss of income for developers; legal fines; pirated copies often contain malware
Using music, images, video or text without permission
Presenting someone else's work as your own
False information spreads quickly on social media
Panic, wrong decisions, damage to reputations
AI-generated fake video/audio of real people
Harm to people and organisations, legal action
Using information without checking its accuracy

blocks.title: Ways to protect intellectual property
rows: Automatic protection of original works; gives the author exclusive rights to copy and distribute
Define exactly how others may use the work
Protect inventions for a fixed period (registered)
Product keys, activation, DRM, watermarks, encryption

blocks.content: To use information legally: check the **licence**, **ask permission**, **cite the source** (author, title, date, URL) and use **open-licence** materials (Creative Commons, public domain).
Providing **government services online**. In Kazakhstan the main portal is **eGov.kz**, with mobile access through the **eGov mobile** app.

blocks.title: Examples of services
rows: Certificate of address registration, no criminal record
Enrolling a child in school or kindergarten, applying for grants
Paying taxes, fines and utility bills
Applying for an ID card, passport or driving licence
Registering with a clinic, booking a doctor's appointment

blocks.title: Signing in securely
items: Sign in with your **IIN** and a password, an **EDS** (electronic digital signature) key, or a one-time code / biometrics in the mobile app.
Keep the EDS key file and its password **private** — it is your legal signature.
Check the website address (`egov.kz`) and HTTPS padlock to avoid **phishing** copies.

blocks.title: Advantages and disadvantages of e-government
rows: Needs Internet access and digital skills
No queues; saves time and travel
Risk of phishing and identity theft
Concerns about the security of personal data
